test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: The present ages of Sweeta and Suman are in the ratio 4 : 5. Six years back, the ratio of their ages was 2 : 3. What is the present age of Sweeta?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of present ages of Sweeta and Suman = 4 : 5

Ratio of their ages 6 years ago = 2 : 3

Difference in ratio parts = (4 − 2) = 2 parts for Sweeta, and (5 − 3) = 2 parts for Suman.

Since the difference in parts is equal, 2 parts difference corresponds to 6 years.

⇒ 1 part = 3 years ⇒ Sweeta's present age = 4 × 3 = 12 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of present ages of Sweeta and Suman = 4 : 5

Ratio of their ages 6 years ago = 2 : 3

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1995fbd4ba6f390fec56f733186fdeae5f229ec5188db31dd2ea4cf625740577.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the present ages of Sweeta and Suman be 4x and 5x years respectively.

6 years ago, Sweeta's age = (4x − 6) years

6 years ago, Suman's age = (5x − 6) years

According to the question,

⇒ (4x − 6) / (5x − 6) = 2 / 3

By cross-multiplying,

⇒ 3 × (4x − 6) = 2 × (5x − 6)

⇒ 12x − 18 = 10x − 12

⇒ 12x − 10x = 18 − 12

⇒ 2x = 6

⇒ x = 3

Sweeta's present age = 4x

⇒ 4 × 3 = 12 years

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equalising Ratio Differences

If the difference between numerator parts and denominator parts isn't equal, multiply the ratios by the difference of their own parts to balance them before equating to the given actual values.

Cross-Multiplication Method

When a ratio a : b changes to c : d by adding or subtracting x to both, the common variable value is found quickly by equating differences: |ad − bc| = x|c − d|.

Past and Future Ages

If present age is n, then t years ago age was (n − t) and t years hence age will be (n + t). The difference in ages of any two people always remains strictly constant over any period of time.
